corpus.t: Membership School runs for 5 weeks: an introductory class in Week 0, then four teaching weeks. Each week you watch a teaching video, attend a review class and take a short test, and you need at least 50% in every test. The Resident Pastor teaches the final week, and certificates are issued digitally by email after the cohort.
corpus.src: CCI Membership School Process, 16 July 2025

corpus.t: If you miss a review class you can continue with the cohort, but you take the make-up class with the next batch to be eligible for graduation and your certificate. If you score below 50% on a test you're given a retake link. Certificates come by email; if yours doesn't arrive, contact the campus follow-up team.
corpus.src: CCI Membership School Process, 16 July 2025

corpus.t: Workers' Onboarding is the next step after Membership School. It's open to members who have completed Membership School and received their Membership Certificate, and it runs for 4 weeks, one class a week. To join, use the onboarding group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/JXH4jWLoVO3HFyJ4ZNDbjV?mode=gi_t
corpus.src: CCI Workers' Onboarding Process Guide, 16 July 2025

corpus.t: To be fully inducted as a worker you attend all four classes, submit the assignment given after Class 1, and pass the final test in Week 4 with at least 60%. If you score below 60% you retake the test with the next batch. No certificate is issued after workers' training.
corpus.src: CCI Workers' Onboarding Process Guide, 16 July 2025

corpus.t: Class 1 and Class 4 are physical and taught by the Resident Pastor. Classes 2 and 3 are taught by the Associate Pastor or an approved trained leader, either virtually or physically depending on the campus.
corpus.src: CCI Workers' Onboarding Process Guide, 16 July 2025

corpus.t: If you miss a class, the assignment or the final test, you don't start over: you complete only the missed part with the next batch. Members who did Membership School years ago can still join, as long as they have their Membership Certificate.
corpus.src: CCI Workers' Onboarding Process Guide, 16 July 2025

corpus.t: Official name and identity: Name: Celebration Church International (CCI). Tagline / culture phrase: “In Christ, For Christ, With Joy.” Vision: “We envision all men celebrating endless life in Christ.” Mandate and emphasis: Knowing Christ and making Christ known; sharing the gospel; making disciples; nurturing spiritual growth; and deploying people to serve and make disciples. Founder and Lead Pastor: Apostle Emmanuel Iren. Origin: The official CCI website says the ministry was founded in 2012. The site's biography explains that Apostle Iren’s ministry began during his undergraduate years at Covenant University, where he founded Triumphant Youth Fellowship in 2008; the fellowship later developed into CCI. Official global website: https://www.joincci.org/ (also https://joincci.org/). Official global “About” page: https://www.joincci.org/about.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Official name and identity

corpus.t: Official name and identity: CCI global website and About page (retrieved 13 October 2026): https://www.joincci.org/ and https://www.joincci.org/about.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Official name and identity

corpus.t: Faith and teaching summary from CCI’s public statement: The official CCI “About” page describes the following core beliefs and emphases: The Bible/Word of God is the ultimate standard for doctrine. The redemptive work of Jesus Christ—His death, burial, and resurrection—is central to the Christian faith and is presented as the greatest demonstration of the Father's love. Believers are made righteous through the grace of the Lord Jesus Christ. The gifts of the Spirit are at work in believers; CCI services include prayer, spiritual songs, and the exercise of spiritual gifts. The church emphasises knowing the truth of Christ, living in the light of that truth, and telling others about Christ. In the official website’s “Know it, Live it, Tell it” framework: Know it: Grow in the knowledge of Christ and understand His lordship through teaching of the Word. Live it: Reflect the life of Jesus in everyday choices, conduct, and relationships.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Faith and teaching summary from CCI’s public statement

corpus.t: Faith and teaching summary from CCI’s public statement: When explaining CCI’s doctrine, stay close to the church's published wording. Do not claim that every individual member holds an identical view on every secondary theological question, and do not fabricate quotations or Bible references.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Faith and teaching summary from CCI’s public statement

corpus.t: What a newcomer can expect: Public pages describe CCI as a community where visitors can worship, learn the Word, pray, grow in faith, make relationships, participate in outreach, join a campus community, attend Membership Classes, explore ministries, and seek pastoral prayer or counselling. The overall tone is welcoming and community-focused. CCI's online language frequently refers to people as family and emphasises progress and joy in the faith. A suitable bot response to “What is CCI?” is:
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: What a newcomer can expect

corpus.t: What a newcomer can expect: “Celebration Church International is a Christian teaching ministry founded by Apostle Emmanuel Iren. CCI’s vision is to see all men celebrating endless life in Christ. The church emphasises the Word of God, the finished work of Jesus, prayer, spiritual growth, evangelism, discipleship, and community. Its culture phrase is ‘In Christ, For Christ, With Joy.’ If you’re asking about the Olu-Obasanjo campus in Port Harcourt, I can help you find the campus page and next steps.”

corpus.t: Size and campus-count caveat: The global homepage currently describes CCI as having over 40 campuses globally and displays a location breakdown of Nigeria 23, Canada 7, United Kingdom 8, United States 4. corpus.t: Counselling, prayer, and welfare: Privacy and safety boundaries: For domestic violence, abuse, self-harm, severe mental distress, medical danger, or threats, encourage immediate safety steps and professional/emergency support as well as pastoral support. Welfare eligibility, aid amounts, and approval timelines are internal; refer requests to the approved welfare contact rather than making promises.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Counselling, prayer, and welfare

corpus.t: Service units and volunteering: CCI websites describe opportunities to serve and promote ministries. At a local campus, volunteers may help welcome guests, support services, communicate information, care for children or teens, organise events, support media, or assist with practical ministry operations. The exact service-unit structure varies by campus. Local operational context supplied for this knowledge base: Olu-Obasanjo campus operations have involved functions such as New Members Integration (NMI), Information Desk, Book Sales, Vendor Management, Membership Class, Data, Welfare, and Event Management. The precise current naming, ownership, and recruitment process should be confirmed with campus leadership. Do not imply every unit is open to every visitor at every time.

corpus.t: Common CCI programmes and names: Sunday Service: the principal weekly corporate gathering. Time and venue are campus-specific and changeable. corpus.t: Short, medium and long descriptions: Short public description: CCI is a church family centred on the gospel of Jesus Christ, the authority of Scripture, discipleship, prayer, worship, community, evangelism and the development of believers who can serve others. Its public vision is “all men celebrating endless life in Christ Jesus.” Its public language includes “In Christ, For Christ, With Joy” and the call to know Christ and make Christ known.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Short, medium and long descriptions

corpus.t: Short, medium and long descriptions: Long public description: Celebration Church International presents itself as a mission-minded teaching ministry. Its official public materials emphasise the death, burial and resurrection of Jesus Christ; Scripture as the standard for doctrine; righteousness received through the grace of Jesus Christ; and the work of the Holy Spirit in the life of the believer. CCI describes its approach as knowing the truth of Christ, living in light of that truth, and telling others about Christ. Community is expressed through worship gatherings, teaching, prayer, evangelism, membership formation, pastoral care, service opportunities and local fellowship.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Short, medium and long descriptions

corpus.t: The three-part “Know it, Live it, Tell it” model: Know it: Help people learn who Jesus is, understand the gospel, and grow in biblical understanding. If a user asks for a sermon, doctrine, or Bible explanation, distinguish a summary of a public CCI teaching from an official position. Link to the original teaching when possible.

corpus.t: The three-part “Know it, Live it, Tell it” model: Live it: Encourage the practical expression of Christian faith in everyday life, relationships, work, service, character, generosity, and community. Avoid shaming language or simplistic explanations of suffering.

corpus.t: Comprehensive FAQ expansion: What is CCI? Celebration Church International, a Christian teaching ministry founded by Apostle Emmanuel Iren. Its vision is to see all men celebrating endless life in Christ Jesus. Official source: https://www.joincci.org/. Is CCI the same as Christ Embassy? No. In this knowledge base, CCI means Celebration Church International. Do not conflate it with another ministry that uses a similar abbreviation. Where is CCI Olu-Obasanjo? The public campus website lists Celebr8 Centre, 35 Olu Obasanjo Road, Elechi, Port Harcourt, Rivers State. Check the latest campus page before travelling: https://ph.joincci.org/. What should I do when I arrive? Ask a steward, welcome team member or Information Desk volunteer for help. If you want follow-up, ask how to complete the official newcomer process.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Comprehensive FAQ expansion

corpus.t: Comprehensive FAQ expansion: Do I have to share my phone number? Do not tell people they must provide contact information unless a current official policy says so. Explain that they can ask the welcome team what information is optional and how it will be used. How do I join a MAP? Ask the campus through its current official channel about the MAP closest to your area. Do not publish private group links or members’ home addresses. What are Membership Classes? A pathway to learn more about CCI’s teaching and community. The next date, format and requirements must be confirmed locally. How do I serve? Tell the campus team what areas interest you and ask about the current volunteer onboarding process. Team availability and requirements vary. Can you tell me who leads my MAP? Only if the leader and contact route are officially published for public use. Otherwise, submit a request through the approved MAP joining process.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Comprehensive FAQ expansion

corpus.t: Comprehensive FAQ expansion: Is this fundraising account legitimate? Do not confirm from a forwarded message alone. Navigate independently to the official website and verify the current giving route, or contact an authorised campus representative through a verified channel. Where can I watch CCI online? Start with the official website at https://www.joincci.org/ and use its current media links. Do not assume every campus livestreams every service. How can I find another campus? Use the global campus locator at https://www.joincci.org/. Confirm address, service time and social links on the destination campus page. What is Triumph30/T30? A devotional/prayer resource referenced in CCI-related public material. Confirm the current official channel, times and format before providing a schedule.
corpus.src: CCI knowledge base: Comprehensive FAQ expansion
